resources.string: The app never connects to the internet and never logs or stores any of your messages or private data. Everything is processed purely in temporary volatile memory to ensure your absolute privacy.

Configure strict, military-grade in-memory privacy protocols to erase traces instantly.

This application converts pending Telegram notifications into a floating overlay showing message counts (e.g., 5 or 6 messages). Tapping the bubble opens the chat directly inside the official Telegram app.
